text: Stopped before editing (checkout /private/tmp/eyes4s-mockscores, slice/mockscores at 53487b30, no commits). SCORES.json lacks a field the mock shows: the focus query P17 ret_07's 19 per-control 2-degree pair scores (fixture.json control_scores_2deg; served by FakeStudyBackend.inspect/pairRows, drawn on Compare-query, Figures panel C 'highest of 19 controls street-112 0.61', Main.dc.html ctrl list). Golden focus B at 2deg is 0.321456 (mock 0.35), so the old 19 scores cannot be kept consistently. Secondary gap: per-participant per-response M and B (fixture GroupMeans m/b, asserted by ReportsSuite) are not in SCORES.json (only D and query count). Owner choices: (a) add focus control pair scores (and optionally per-group M/B) to SCORES.json via StudioScores.scala; (b) let the mock drop control pair scores (served as NotServed) and derive group M/B from SCORES query rows; (c) another source. Structural fields (item, match, response, status, controls) of all 466 golden queries already agree with fixture.json.
